mapper.select: SELECT * FROM registrar_jobs WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registrar_jobs (domain_id, job_type, payload, status, attempts, max_attempts) VALUES (#{domainId}, #{jobType}, #{payload}::jsonb, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{maxAttempts})
mapper.update: UPDATE registrar_jobs SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE registrar_jobs SET status = 'FAILED', attempts = #{attempts}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE registrar_jobs SET status = 'DEAD', last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM registrar_jobs WHERE domain_id = #{domainId} ORDER BY id DESC
